title: MW Jet Ski Rentals
specs: Operate jet ski within 1 mile radius designated area
Only adult riders and passengers 18+ who have signed the waiver and release
Maximum total weight 500 pounds per jet ski
No passengers under 18 allowed on jet ski at any time

gap: Exact address and contact phone/email not stated
blurb: Guests rent jet skis for 1 hour rides within a designated 1 mile radius. Only adults 18+ who sign a waiver may operate the jet skis. Safety rules include wearing life vests, no alcohol or drugs, and no passengers under 18 on the jet skis.
extraNote: Jet ski bookings are non-refundable · Scheduling changes can be made up to 48 hours before departure · If unable to ride due to weather, vouchers issued redeemable for 12 months · Vouchers transferable to another person · $250 minimum charge for any and all damages to jet ski · Overtime charges $2 per minute · Jet skis must be returned 75% full of gas or $30 fuel fee applies · Violation of rules results in forfeiture of full $250 deposit · Jet ski rollover requires minimum $50 inspection payment
